meta.title: Lingo - Your AI Mouthpiece In Game
meta.description: Lingo is your in-game AI mouthpiece: understand teammates, translate what you mean, and drop it straight back into chat.

hero.title: Translate & Chat
hero.subtitle: Lingo is your AI mouthpiece in game. Read the callout, shape your reply, and send it back to chat without dropping the match.
hero.helper: The best installer is highlighted for your device.

mockup.title: Say it cleanly, send it fast
mockup.body: Type your line in Chinese, hit the hotkey, and Lingo turns BKB, take the fight, and wait up into English that sounds like something a real teammate would send.
mockup.source: 先别接，等我 BKB 好了我们再打。
mockup.result: Don't force yet. Wait for my BKB, then we take the fight.
mockup.chatDraft: Don't force yet. Wait for my BKB, then we take the fight.
mockup.sideBody: Short sentences, stable tone, and low-friction communication for live matches.

features.title: Not just translation. Your in-game AI mouthpiece.
features.subtitle: It does more than swap words. Lingo keeps callouts short, readable, and ready to fire inside the same chat rhythm.

instant.title: One-key reply
instant.description: Highlight a line or draft your own, hit the hotkey, and let the AI handle the busywork.

server.title: Context-aware AI
server.description: Models and updates stay on the backend so the output gets shorter, cleaner, and more usable in live matches.

phrases.title: Callouts on standby
phrases.description: Keep common lines like push, back, wait, and regroup ready to send without retyping every round.

languages.title: Chat across languages
languages.description: Move between Chinese, English, and Russian servers without losing the flow of conversation.

supportedGames.title: Closer to a real teammate in the games where chat still matters.
supportedGames.subtitle: We are starting with Dota 2, League of Legends, World of Warcraft, and Overwatch 2, then expanding to other games where quick typed chat still carries the team.
supportedGames.note: If a game gives you a chat box, Lingo can usually step in to read faster, reply cleaner, and keep the tempo moving.

dota2.name: Dota 2
dota2.description: Ideal for smoke calls, BKB timing, retreat pings, and the short tempo lines that decide fights.

lol.name: League of Legends
lol.description: Lane reminders, jungle timing, resource trades, and teamfight callouts come out faster and sound more natural.

wow.name: World of Warcraft
wow.description: Useful for raid calls, regroup reminders, party chat, and multilingual coordination in the same group.

ow2.name: Overwatch 2
ow2.description: Great for position callouts, focus targets, regroup timing, and cleaner replies in squad chat.

howItWorks.title: Three steps from intent to send.
howItWorks.subtitle: Lingo works like an AI mouthpiece bound to a hotkey: understand, translate, then send it back to chat.

select.title: Give it the line
select.description: Select the teammate message or type what you want to say.

hotkey.title: Hit the hotkey
hotkey.description: One shortcut triggers copy, translation, and cleanup in the background.

paste.title: Send the draft
paste.description: The ready-to-send result lands back in the current chat box.

download.title: Install it now. Let AI speak for you next match.
download.subtitle: Direct installers use a Tencent Cloud mirror for faster regional downloads, with a fallback link to the full GitHub releases page.
